children: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC International (IFSC) Ltd, the wholly owned GIFT City subsidiary of Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, has introduced two retail fund-of-funds schemes, targeting resident Indian investors seeking overseas exposure and non-resident Indians (NRIs) and foreign investors looking to participate in India’s growth.

The two offerings — ABSL Emerging Market Equity Fund (Outbound) and ABSL India Growth Fund (Inbound) — mark the subsidiary’s initial retail product launch at the Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City) International Financial Services Centre (IFSC), stated an official release here on Friday.

The ABSL Emerging Market Equity Fund is an open-ended thematic fund of funds that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in units of the ARGA Emerging Market Equity Fund and/or other emerging-market funds. The fund will provide eligible resident Indians with access to global emerging markets through the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) route, while eligible Indian corporates can invest through the Overseas Portfolio Investment (OPI) route. The offering builds on ABSL AMC’s existing close-ended emerging-market fund offerings, now being relaunched in an open-ended format under the IFSC subsidiary.

The ABSL India Growth Fund, meanwhile, will invest in equity-oriented schemes of Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund, including exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and index funds. The actively managed fund will dynamically allocate investments across schemes, sectors, market capitalisations and investment themes. The minimum initial investment is $500, with additional investments in multiples of $100. Subsequent investments can start at $100, also in multiples of $100, according to the company.

Commenting on the launch, A. Balasubramanian, managing director and chief executive of Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, said the IFSC subsidiary would help the company build global investment capabilities from India. “The Emerging Market Equity Fund and India Growth Fund form the initial offerings in this journey, and we intend to progressively build a differentiated suite of global investment solutions from the IFSC,” he said. ABSL AMC established its presence in GIFT City through a branch operation in 2022. The new wholly owned subsidiary marks an expansion of that presence into a dedicated platform for developing and offering investment products under the IFSC regulatory framework.

title: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC launches two retail funds from GIFT City
